name: Band Curl
cues: Stand on the middle of the band with feet about hip width
Hold the ends palms up with your elbows at your sides
Curl until your hands reach your shoulders
Lower under control to straight arms

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: The band anchors and stretches plausibly (fixed floor points, handle rings). Bands carry no collision geometry, though, and my own band-segment check finds the strand 8 to 9 mm inside the forearm capsule at the top frames (0 and 110), where it drops from the ring past the curled forearm. No gate sees this.
